name: gh-flow
description: Carry a GitHub issue all the way to a reviewed PR in one run. Six skills: the ordinary path, where the issue and the PR live on the same reachable remote; the relay path, for a destination remote whose git push a proxy blocks; a backlog drain that finishes only when every deferred item has become an issue of its own; and dependency waves that run a set of issues in parallel worktrees with a live-verify barrier between waves.
